props.title: Outreach Teams
props.description: Serving Grand Rapids — the food, the neighbors, and the days our city already turns out for.

props.heading: Outreach Teams
props.lede: The third direction: not the church down the road, not the Caribbean — the street outside.

props.heading: Grand Rapids is the assignment too.
props.subline: A few times a year, and some of it every week
props.body:
An Outreach Team is a group from New Life going somewhere in this city to do something useful — packing food, delivering groceries, showing up on the days the whole neighborhood is already outside.

Some of it is one big day a year. Some of it is a Sunday afternoon that repeats. You don't need a skill to come; you need to be free that day.

facts.label: Who can come
facts.value: Anyone — families welcome, kids included on most of it

facts.label: Partners
facts.value: Serve GR, Mission of Hope, and our neighbors in Briggs Park

cards.title: Meals of Hope
cards.text: One November afternoon, hundreds of people, two hours, thousands of packed meals. Kids scoop, teens seal, adults weigh.

cards.title: Serve GR
cards.text: We partner with Serve GR for a summer outreach day across the city.

cards.title: National Night Out
cards.text: Showing up in August on the night the neighborhoods are already out on their porches.

cards.title: Briggs Park groceries
cards.text: Weekly grocery delivery in the neighborhood after Sunday service.

props.title: The need is on our street.
props.body:
It is easier to care about a place you fly to than the one you drive through. Overseas has a departure date and a photo at the end; a neighbor two blocks away has neither.

So we put our own city on the calendar the same way we put the Dominican Republic on it — with dates, teams, and someone responsible for showing up.

props.title: Tell us you're in.
props.body: We'll let you know the next date, where to be, and what we're doing. Come to one or come to all of them.

cards.label: To the local church
cards.title: Ambassador Teams
cards.body: One Sunday a month we worship at another Grand Rapids church, having prayed for them all month, and hand over a letter and a gift.

cards.label: To our partners overseas
cards.title: Missions Teams
cards.body: A week in the Caribbean with Mission of Hope — medical care, kids clubs, construction, whatever the team is built to do.
